caption: Risk Aggregate Finding
description:
The Risk Aggregate Finding aggregates other findings and can represent risk combined from multiple intermediate findings via a weighted algorithm and/or time-based accumulation.

Note: If the event producer is a security control, the security_control profile should be applied and its attacks information, if present, should be duplicated into the finding_info object.
Note: If the Finding is an incident, i.e. requires incident workflow, also apply the incident profile.
name: risk_aggregate_finding

finding_info_list.description:
A list of finding_info objects representing intermediate findings that contributed to this finding. Use this list when this finding's finding_info.analytic evaluates other findings to produce the current finding. The intermediate findings may each include their own finding_info.related_events describing the events or activities analyzed to produce them.

Note: If this finding is based on both intermediate findings and non-finding events or activities, include only the intermediate findings in this list. Capture the complete set of contributing inputs in this finding's finding_info.related_events, including any references to those intermediate findings.
